lastCompletedStory.title: Extract resolveSelfInvokeArgv primitive and delegate resolveOrchResolverCmd to it

nextStoryContext: resolveSelfInvokeArgv (src/util/self-invoke.ts) is now the single canonical fix site for interpreted-vs-compiled self-invoke detection, keyed ONLY on the positive argv1.startsWith('/$bunfs/') signal. resolveOrchResolverCmd (src/commands/run.ts) is a thin wrapper: argv = resolveSelfInvokeArgv(execPath, argv1); return argv.map(q).join(' ') + ' orch-resolve'. The negative basename(execPath) !== 'bun' heuristic is fully removed from src/ (the basename import was dropped from run.ts since it had no other use there -- do not re-add it without checking for actual other call sites first). patterns.md's CAM-425 US-R1-001 bullet documents the OLD two-signal design and is now stale re: detection logic; left as-is per Surgical Changes (out of scope for this story to edit a historical bullet describing a past fix), but any future work continuing this thread should treat src/util/self-invoke.ts + its doc comment as the current source of truth, not that bullet. forkMonitor (src/retry/launcher.ts) still carries the same latent self-invoke bug class (noted as an out-of-scope follow-up target in the CAM-425 bullet) and has NOT been touched by this story -- still a plausible future target if a story ever asks for it.
